programs.title: No Demo Reno
programs.desc: A couple left the custom home they loved in Utah for her job; Jenn's goal is to get them to fall in love all over again by infusing a custom, contemporary vibe without changing the layout.

programs.title: Life Is Messy
programs.desc: Matt and Sam are at their wit's end. The daily grind of raising two young kids while juggling careers and Matt's busy marathon schedule has worn them down. They have no time to keep their home organized and clutter has consumed their lives, taking a toll on their relationship. Kortney and Kenny help them through the emotional journey of letting go, so they can get their home organized, functional, and a place to love again.

programs.title: That Thrifting Show with Lara Spencer
programs.desc: Sunshine sets the stage as Lara Spencer pits two teams against each other in a sunroom design showdown. Grandma-core faces off with Brownstone Classic, bringing ambitious plans, creative DIYs, and more plants than you can count.

programs.title: That Thrifting Show with Lara Spencer
programs.desc: Lara Spencer challenges two teams to thrift and transform a space into a swanky speakeasy, pitting Moroccan flair against Art Deco glamour as they hunt for standout pieces and reimagine secondhand finds into dramatic, high-style designs.
